fulfillments.description: Open the campaign and edit the banner to fit your brand and messaging. Launch the campaign in just a few clicks with this ready-made template developed by our e-commerce experts.
fulfillments.headline: Banner

fulfillments.description: This is an aggregate used to display a personalized text message in the banner. Map the string name of the chosen holiday destination here. If you wish to change the content of the banner, feel free to map other information from the latest research conducted on the website.
fulfillments.headline: Personalized Holiday Destination

fulfillments.description: This is an aggregate used to display a personalized text message in the banner. Map the string name of the chosen entity (e.g. hotel, resort...) here. If you wish to change the content of the banner, feel free to map other information from the latest research conducted on the website.
fulfillments.headline: Personalized Entity Name

fulfillments.description: This is an aggregate used to display a personalized text message in the banner. Map the string format of start date. If you wish to change the content of the banner, feel free to map other information from the latest research conducted on the website.
fulfillments.headline: Personalized Start Date

fulfillments.description: This is an aggregate used to display a personalized text message in the banner. Map the last viewed url here. It is also possible to create an url based on the information tracked in your events. To do so, create the url directly in the banner ("Url parameter"). If you wish to change the content of the banner, feel free to map other information from the latest research conducted on the website.
fulfillments.headline: Personalized URL
